new_family_perm4.generator: experiments/worlds_006.py world(seed,'perm4'): rng=random.Random(seed*104729+211); n=4; two transition permutations p0=list(range(4)) shuffled by rng, p1=list(range(4)) shuffled by rng (in that order); transitions[s]=(p0[s],p1[s]); codes=rng.sample(range(4),3); emissions=[codes[0],codes[0],codes[1],codes[2]] then rng.shuffle(emissions); start=rng.randrange(4); returns a bgr89.worlds.HiddenWorld(4,transitions,emissions,start,seed,'perm4') so that observed() and the sensor mask are identical to the other families; passive actions bgr89.worlds.actions(seed,44)

alarm_rule.tau6_calibration: run P4 with the alarm disabled (tau=+inf, so no alarm and no resume) on every calibration case (calibration_ranges_tau6 x 3 mask rates = 1500 cases, passive sequence bgr89.worlds.actions(seed,44)); tau6 = the maximum residual_after (window W=8, same residual definition as v0.1.1) over every step of every calibration case, rounded to 12 decimals. Per-family maxima are recorded. No out-of-family or held-out data is used.
alarm_rule.resume: once an alarm is set (residual > tau6), certification is withheld as in v0.3.0. While the alarm is set, count consecutive observe() steps with residual_after <= tau6; when the count reaches W=8 AND the <=4 family and <=5 margin are both supported, the alarm clears (alarm_step=None, count reset, resumes += 1) and certification may resume from the next predict. A new residual > tau6 sets the alarm again. A family or margin contradiction stays permanent (never resumed).
alarm_rule.attestation: public certificates are never re-enabled after the first alarm of a session: the frozen v0.1.1 learner already sets attestation=None on any alarm, so after a resume certificates are conditional only (public_certificate None, public_reason UNATTESTED_SCOPE). Diagnostics add first_alarm_step, alarm_steps (every step an alarm was set) and resume_steps.

candidate_rules.LU2-R: score2(a)=mean over c in S4(a) of [N(a,c) + max over a2 in {0,1} of mean over c2 in S4'(a2) of N'(a2,c2)], where S4' and N' are computed on the family/margin copies after (a,c); N is the LU-R count (single code passing Y1k on the copy, margin copy agreeing). Tie -> default action; rounding 12 d.p.; budget-exceeding copies score 0.
candidate_rules.F2: the certificate x for b must equal the union over every surviving row and every state j reachable from a visited state compatible with the mask of observation t-2 through the recorded actions/observations t-1, t (each step: known edge, target compatible with that observation mask) of: masks[trans[j,b]] if known; if unknown and j is current: all visited masks plus ALL if used<4; if unknown and not current: skipped (Y1k convention). w=2.

representation.name: brute/geometry.py ConstraintRegion: the H-representation of the version space
representation.framing: The enumeration learner stores the version space as a list of rows (a V-representation: its points). ConstraintRegion stores it as CNF constraints over complete <=n Moore machines (an H-representation: the half-spaces that cut it out). Canonical first-visit state naming is a fundamental domain of the S_n relabelling action, so the region is represented on the quotient. Each query the learner needs is a geometric operation on the region: support(b) is the projection on the next-code coordinate; saturation is an emptiness test of the sub-region with an unused state; the Y1k/F2 certificate is a fibre over the latest observations; an observation is a cut (new clauses). Size grows with n^2 * steps clauses instead of the number of consistent machines. This is a step toward the long-term goal of a geometric reasoning system; it is not evidence of general intelligence.
representation.solver: python-sat (pysat) Glucose3, canonical first-visit symmetry breaking; one fresh solver per (evidence prefix, cap); queries by assumptions

GR1_exactness_sealed.threshold: on every step of every sealed trace of study-004 arms A and P and study-005 arms A3 and P3 (504 + 504 + 504 + 504 traces, taken AND counterfactual action), ConstraintRegion at n=4 and n=5 rebuilt from the recorded initial observation, actions and observations reproduces exactly: family and margin feasibility (status supported vs contradicted), support (n=4), margin_support (n=5), saturated, and for study-005 A3/P3 the Y1k decision (CERTIFIED vs RESYNC_AMBIGUOUS given a single-code support); and for active arms (A, A3) both LU / LU-R experiment scores at every step where the trace records them. Steps where the enumeration hit its row budget are excluded and counted separately. Report = a COUNT of mismatching (trace, step, field) items over everything (no stop at first); PASS iff 0.

GR1b_exactness_006.threshold: same check on study-006 A4 and P4 traces (support, margin support, saturation, Y1k decision, LU-R scores for A4), and the D2 LU2-R scores and the F2 fibre decision on a pre-registered subsample (first 4 seeds per family, all masks); 0 mismatches

GR2_scaling.report: for 84 cases (study-006 heldout: first 4 seeds of each of the 7 original families x 3 masks): enumeration (bgr90 SymbolicLearner) vs ConstraintRegion at n=2..6 on the passive sequence: per-step wall-clock, peak rows (enumeration) vs variables and clauses (region), per-case totals; SAT-only at n=8, 10, 12 on the same cases (enumeration capped at 6). Fitted log-log slope of time vs n for each. Hypothesis (Inferred, not gated): region size grows polynomially in n while enumeration rows grow exponentially on high-mask cases.
GR2_scaling.prediction: mixed: SAT faster when rows are large (ood5 high mask), slower on small regions (Observed in design)
